name: Torrent to Google Drive Bot
description: A Telegram bot that downloads torrents and uploads them to Google Drive with direct streaming links

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Admin username for the built-in web user. Defaults to MonsterZeroX if not set.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for the built-in web user. Defaults to Kaveesha@2005 if not set.

DEFAULT_INVITE_CODE.description: Invite code automatically created for first-time setup. Defaults to Kaveesha if not set.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed for CORS (useful for the Next.js frontend).

RCLONE_CONFIG.description: Your rclone.conf file content (entire file as a single value). Encode this properly or use base64 if needed.

RCLONE_CONFIG_PATH.description: Filesystem path where the rclone config will be written. Defaults to /app/rclone.conf.

RCLONE_REMOTE_NAME.description: The name of your rclone remote (e.g., 'gdrive' if your rclone.conf has [gdrive])

RCLONE_BASE_DIR.description: Base directory on Google Drive where files will be uploaded

INDEX_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of your Google Drive index for generating direct links (e.g., https://index.yourdomain.com). Leave empty if you don't have an index.

OWNER_IDS.description: Comma-separated list of Telegram user IDs who can use the bot (leave empty to allow all users)

SEED_TIME.description: Time to seed after download in seconds (0 = no seeding)

DATABASE_URL.description: Full database connection string. Heroku Postgres will populate this automatically.

TMDB_API_KEY.description: TMDB v3 API key (set either this or TMDB_API).

TMDB_API.description: Alternate TMDB v3 API key env name supported by the app.

TMDB_BEARER.description: TMDB v4 bearer token (auto-prefixed if missing Bearer).

TMDB_TOKEN.description: Alternate TMDB v4 bearer token env name supported by the app.

GENIE_API_KEY.description: Genie Business Connect API key used for paid plan upgrades.

GENIE_MERCHANT_ID.description: Merchant ID for Genie Business Connect.

GENIE_API_BASE.description: Base API URL for Genie Business Connect (override if the default endpoint changes).

GENIE_CREATE_PAYMENT_URL.description: Optional override for the Genie create payment endpoint if your account uses a different path.

GENIE_PAYMENT_STATUS_URL.description: Optional override template for payment status lookups (use {payment_id} in the URL).

GENIE_CURRENCY.description: Currency code used for paid plans (defaults to LKR).

PLAN_100_PRICE_LKR.description: Override price (LKR) for the 100GB/day plan (defaults to 300).

PLAN_300_PRICE_LKR.description: Override price (LKR) for the 300GB/day plan (defaults to 600).

PLAN_UNLIMITED_PRICE_LKR.description: Override price (LKR) for the unlimited plan (defaults to 1200).

MEGA_EMAIL.description: Mega.nz premium account email (optional; anonymous mode used if empty).

MEGA_PASSWORD.description: Mega.nz premium account password (optional; anonymous mode used if empty).

PORT.description: Port for the Flask web server (Heroku sets this automatically).

SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for Flask sessions (auto-generated if not set)

scripts.postdeploy: echo 'Bot deployed successfully! Use /start in your Telegram bot to begin.'
